text: Underway in round one.
Tortoise calls for calm and covers their own half.
Hare loses balance in midfield and hits the deck.
Teammates collide, and Tortoise hits the deck.
Spark breaks clean through down the right channel!
Just wide of the open goal!
Spark drives straight back into range.
Muse turns it home! It is AFC Fable nil, Muse Spark one!
The spark-blue shirts keep pressing high, querying their language model on every touch while Fable struggle to clear.
Spark bursts through the middle again.
Spark doubles the lead from point-blank range. That makes it AFC Fable nil, Muse Spark two, and the visitors are in full control.
Tortoise carries play up the middle.
Tortoise bundles it in to pull one back! AFC Fable one, Muse Spark two, and Fable's pre-programmed logic strikes right back.
Tortoise levels the match! A second goal in minutes makes it AFC Fable two, Muse Spark two!
Tortoise shouts to Hare, retreating goal-side to protect the net.
The corner ram fires the ball clear.
A bit of miscommunication there as Muse and Spark bump into each other in their own third, sending Muse sprawling.
Hare is through on goal!
Inches away! Hare snatches at the shot and it scrapes past the post.
Muse steps in with a firm challenge on the left channel, knocking Hare to the turf.
Fable maintain the sustained attacking pressure.
Tortoise takes an awkward tumble out on the wing.
Spark calls out to Muse, looking to pry the loose ball away from the touchline.
The push-panel launches it back out.
Tortoise comes across forcefully to dispossess Spark, leaving the spark-blue forward flat on the carpet.
Muse regains possession and drives five metres up the right wing into midfield.
Muse finishes at the mouth of the goal! Muse Spark lead again, AFC Fable two, Muse Spark three!
Tortoise calls for the ball in their own third, promising a steady advance forward.
Tortoise bundles it in for a hat-trick! Level once again, AFC Fable three, Muse Spark three!
Spark is clean through the middle!
Tortoise tracks back and crunches into Muse, denying the chance with authority.
Spark fires it home from the right channel! What a see-saw contest, AFC Fable three, Muse Spark four!
Spark trips and falls out wide.
The corner panel thumps the ball right back into the danger area.
Tortoise shouts to cut off the rolling ball.
Another corner panel kick-out.
Muse Spark have Fable pinned deep in the closing seconds of the half, recycling possession with patience.
Fable teammates collide in midfield.
That brings a breathless first half to a close. Seven goals shared already, with Muse Spark holding a four-three edge over AFC Fable.
Tortoise glances it just wide!
Tortoise pounces on the rebound and scores! We are all square again, AFC Fable four, Muse Spark four!
Tortoise scores again from close range! AFC Fable lead for the first time today, five to four!
Hare shouts across that they have the loose ball covered, promising no lapses in concentration.
Spark breaks clear from midfield with nobody ahead of them!
Spark drives purposefully toward goal.
Spark slots it into the corner! Ten goals in this match and we are tied, AFC Fable five, Muse Spark five!
Muse calls out with attacking intent as they look to push forward.
Hare finds daylight on the left and has a clear sight of goal!
Flies just past the upright!
Into the final two and a half minutes, and Fable are piling on the pressure in search of another lead.
Hare scrambles it over the line! With just over two minutes remaining, AFC Fable take a six-five lead!
Tortoise powers right through the centre.
Tortoise immediately adds another! What a blitz, AFC Fable lead Muse Spark seven to five with two minutes to play!
Tortoise halts Muse with a clatter.
Muse scrambles forward along the touchline.
Muse clatters Hare to the ground.
Muse scores! The deficit is cut to one, AFC Fable seven, Muse Spark six!
Tortoise rallies Hare from the centre circle, calling for calm and promising to anchor their own half.
Tortoise stands firm on the left touchline, upending Spark to stop the counter.
Spark loses footing under pressure and goes down, with time rapidly ticking away for Muse Spark.
The push-panel fires the ball away from the corner, keeping it alive as we tick into the final minute.
Muse drives up through the centre of the pitch, desperately looking for an equaliser with under forty seconds left.
Spark levels it in the final half-minute! It is AFC Fable seven, Muse Spark seven! Unbelievable drama!
The corner panel rebounds the ball one last time with seconds remaining.
Seven all at full time. Codex City face Gemini Flash Friday: twelve UK, thirteen Europe, seven US East.
